method: Net-new live checks integrated after peer passes P12-P14. Every confirmed value was found on the official page named in the check; missing values stay null.
integration_note: This session's earlier overlapping draft was dropped during rebase after peer P12-P14 landed. Their dated calculation anchor, live-check reference row, F39-F45 findings and all merged files are preserved. P15 appends only checks and fixes not already present: five Dataset C weight rows, NIST attribution, VRAI/Automic flags and calculator provenance.

checks.label: NIST precious-metals page does not print the previously attributed troy-ounce figure
checks.findings: Live page returns HTTP 200 and reproduces NIST Handbook 130 sec. 2.17 with a linked conversion PDF, but prints no troy-ounce-to-gram figure. Corrected the attribution in spot-and-standards.json and published F46; the peer historical evidence file was not overwritten (CR-P15-1).

checks.label: NIST SP 811 Appendix B.9 supplies the troy-ounce and exact grain factors
checks.findings: Live page prints 'ounce (troy or apothecary) (oz) -> gram (g) | 3.110 348 | E+01' and 'grain (gr) -> kilogram (kg) | 6.479 891 | E-05' in boldface (exact). Exactly 480 grains per troy ounce gives 480 x 0.06479891 = 31.1034768 g, so the constant remains valid.

checks.label: R28 VRAI Petite 4-Prong weight confirmed; SPEC7 ring name, source and price text corrected
checks.findings: Both chunks print 'Band: Plain band', 'Metal: 18k Yellow Gold', 'Metal weight: 2.3g' and 'Pavé carat weight: 0.11ctw'. No price appears in static text, so price_usd stays null. SPEC7 had named Signature 6-Prong, linked another URL and mentioned $1,460; corrected and published as F47.

checks.label: R23 Automic Coffin Ring weight confirmed; same-page production-time contradiction flagged
checks.findings: Chunk 4 confirms $1,910 and 'Approximately 6.1g (gold) or 9.2g (platinum)'. The buy box says 'Production time is 1 to 5 business days' while Details says '1-2 weeks' (2-3 weeks engraved). Added SPEC5 to R23 and published F48; no weight or price changed.

checks.label: BND-04 Ross-Simons Women's 2mm 14kt band - gold weight and price
checks.findings: Live page prints 'Gold Weight 1.7 grams', 'Metal 14kt Yellow Gold' and $400 verbatim. All weights and measurements are labelled approximate by the seller.

checks.findings: Live page prints 'Gold Weight 4.2 grams', 'Metal 14kt Yellow Gold' and $949 verbatim.

checks.findings: Live page prints 'Gold Weight 4.0 grams', 'Metal 14kt Yellow Gold', Width 3/4 inch and $1,195 verbatim. The page also shows a cart-level promotional banner; the stored list price is unchanged.

checks.label: BND-07 Ross-Simons Italian 14kt Fleur-De-Lis Signet Ring - gold weight and price
checks.findings: Live page prints 'Gold Weight 2.1 grams', 'Metal 14kt Yellow Gold', Width 1/2 inch and $599 verbatim.

checks.label: BND-08 Ross-Simons 22kt Eagle coin ring in 14kt setting - gold weight and price
checks.findings: Live page prints 'Gold Weight 5.9 grams', 'Metal 14kt and 22kt Gold' and $3,295 verbatim. The single 5.9 g figure spans two finenesses, so the mixed-karat caveat remains and no single-karat melt value is inferred.

checks.label: Kitco purity table independently corroborates the fineness arithmetic without changing the dated anchor
checks.findings: At the P15 live read, Kitco printed bid 3,996.00 / ask 3,998.00 at 'Oct 23, 2026 - 16:18 NY Time', 14K = 2,330.87 USD/oz, 128.47 USD/g and 'A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams'. 3996.00 x 14/24 = 2331.00 and 3996.00/31.1034768 = 128.4744, agreeing to rounding. This is corroboration only; the peer-reviewed dated calculation anchor is preserved.

checks.label: BND-06 official identity corrects the extended calculator preset label
checks.findings: The official product is 'Italian 14kt Yellow Gold Diamond-Cut Dome Ring' (3/4 inch wide), not the template's 'Ross-Simons 6mm 14K Flat'. Calculator presets now derive the real product name, weight, price and ratio from Dataset C JSON; published as F49.

summary.combined_weight_coverage: P14 covers 14 Dataset B rows; P15 covers the remaining 5 Dataset C rows, so 19/19 published-weight rows have a current live check.
